findings.reason: the plan has to name the registration path (a new scorecard field with its own emitter, or a separate edge-tolerance constant beside the registry) before a node can place the threshold the edge criterion and the analytic negative control are both judged against.
findings.text: §5 requires its edge threshold to be "registered in the same tolerance owner, beside `PROFILE_RESIDUAL_RMS`", but `nova/imas/parity_tolerances.py` admits no such entry: `registered_tolerances` raises `RuntimeError("the parity tolerance registry is incomplete")` unless the keyed set exactly equals `SCORECARD_FIELDS` (`nova/imas/parity_tolerances.py:250-251`), `SCORECARD_FIELDS` is derived one-to-one from the `ScorecardField` enum (`nova/imas/parity_tolerances.py:39`), and `scorecard_verdicts` enforces the same exact coverage on every scorecard it scores (`nova/imas/parity_tolerances.py:277`). So a new bound there is not a registration beside `PROFILE_RESIDUAL_RMS`: it forces a new `ScorecardField` member, which in turn forces the MAST parity chain's `_registered_scorecard_metrics` (`nova/imas/mast_parity_chain.py:530-584`, the only producer of that mapping) to emit the band metric — a metric §5 computes on IDS reads at DD3/DD4, which that chain never sees. As written, the node either trips the import-time `RuntimeError` or improvises a placement the plan did not authorise
